newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile June copper output up five pct from 1996.
newsitem.headline: Chile June copper output up five pct from 1996.

text.p: Chile produced 272,394 tonnes of fine copper in June, a rise of five percent on output in the same month last year, said the National Statistics Institute.
The figure brings copper output in the first six months of the year to 1.69 million tonnes, an increase of 12.3 percent on the first half of last year.
June's copper production figures included 116,149 tonnes of copper in concentrates and 128,911 tonnes of electrolitic copper, including cathodes.
Chilean metallic mining production grew 3.5 percent in June, while non-metallic output increased 30.5 percent.
